_comment: The At a glance box under each condition page's H1 (tools/service_pages.py).
who:        plain language, who the page is for. Written to match the home page cards.
treatments: the named treatments offered. Clinical - confirm with Dr. Gupta before filling.
duration:   how long treatment usually takes. Clinical - confirm with Dr. Gupta.
A row with an empty value is not rendered, so nothing is ever claimed on his behalf.

psychiatrist-de-addiction-treatment-delh.who: Alcohol, drug or tobacco dependence, with or without withdrawal.

psychiatrist-alcohol-deaddiction-treatme.who: Drinking that has become difficult to stop, or is causing harm.

smoking-cessation.who: Tobacco or nicotine dependence, including after earlier attempts to quit.

schizophrenia-psychiatrist-delhi-gurgaon.who: Hallucinations, delusions, or withdrawal from ordinary life.

best-bipolar-disorder-psychiatrist-delhi.who: Swings between elevated and low mood that disrupt work or relationships.

depression-psychiatrist-doctor-in-delhi-.who: Low mood, exhaustion or loss of interest lasting weeks.

best-psychiatrist-anxiety-specialist-del.who: Constant worry or panic attacks that take over the day.

ocd-psychiatrist-in-gurgaon-delhi-ncr.who: Obsessive thoughts and compulsions that are hard to resist.

stress-management-psychiatrist-delhi-gur.who: Stress that is affecting sleep, work or relationships.

personality-disorder-treatment-delhi-ind.who: Long-standing patterns in mood, identity and relationships.

borderline-personality-disorder.who: Intense emotions, unstable relationships and fear of abandonment.

narcissistic-personality-disorder.who: Patterns of grandiosity and difficulty with criticism or empathy.

schizotypal-personality-disorder.who: Odd beliefs or perceptions alongside discomfort in close relationships.

eating-disorder-psychiatrist-delhi-gurga.who: Restricting, bingeing or purging, and distress about weight or shape.
